research_notes: The durable-state-first rule is especially important once refinement begins because target classes may move non-monotonically within a bracket.
Hard-coded ascent text could otherwise incorrectly jump past a failed boundary.
The algorithm should therefore read phase, last clean, candidate failure, and next target from state each run.
The research documents define classification rules, while state selects the current step.
This separation is stable and compact.
Current state still selects strict 14m retry until close.
